sentences.en: More than a third of the Earth's top layer is at risk.
sentences.zh: 超过三分之一的地球表层处于危险之中。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Is there hope for our planet’s most precious resource?
sentences.zh: 我们星球上最宝贵的资源还有希望吗？

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: A More than a third of the world’s soil is endangered, according to a recent UN report.
sentences.zh: A 根据联合国最近的一份报告,世界上超过三分之一的土壤受到威胁。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: If we don’t slow the decline, all farmable soil could be gone in 60 years.
sentences.zh: 如果我们不减缓衰退速度,所有可耕地可能会在 60 年内消失。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Since soil grows 95% of our food, and sustains human life in other more surprising ways, that is a huge problem.
sentences.zh: 由于土壤种植了我们 95% 的食物,并以其他更令人惊讶的方式维持着人类的生命,这是一个巨大的问题。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: B Peter Groffman, from the Cary Institute of Ecosystem Studies in New York, points out that soil scientists have been warning about the degradation of the world's soil for decades.
sentences.zh: 纽约卡里生态系统研究所的 B Peter Groffman 指出,几十年来,土壤科学家一直在警告世界土壤退化。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: At the same time, our understanding of its importance to humans has grown.
sentences.zh: 与此同时,我们对其对人类重要性的理解也不断加深。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: A single gram of healthy soil might contain 100 million bacteria, as well as other microorganisms such as viruses and fungi, living amid decomposing plants and various minerals.
sentences.zh: 一克健康的土壤可能含有一亿个细菌,以及其他微生物,如病毒和真菌,生活在分解的植物和各种矿物质中。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: That means soils do not just grow our food, but are the source of nearly all our existing antibiotics, and could be our best hope in the fight against antibioticresistant bacteria.
sentences.zh: 这意味着土壤不仅种植我们的食物,而且是我们现有的几乎所有抗生素的来源,并且可能是我们对抗抗生素耐药细菌的最大希望。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Soil is also an ally against climate change: as microorganisms within soil digest dead animals and plants, they lock in their carbon content, holding three times the amount of carbon as does the entire atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 土壤也是应对气候变化的盟友：当土壤中的微生物消化死去的动植物时,它们会锁定碳含量,其碳含量是整个大气的三倍。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Soils also store water, preventing flood damage: in the UK, damage to buildings, roads and bridges from floods caused by soil degradation costs £233 million every year.
sentences.zh: 土壤还可以储存水,防止洪水破坏：在英国,土壤退化造成的洪水对建筑物、道路和桥梁的破坏每年造成 2.33 亿英镑的损失。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: C If the soil loses its ability to perform these functions, the human race could be in big trouble.
sentences.zh: C 如果土壤失去执行这些功能的能力,人类可能会遇到大麻烦。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The danger is not that the soil will disappear completely, but that the microorganisms that give it its special properties will be lost.
sentences.zh: 危险不是土壤会完全消失,而是赋予土壤特殊性质的微生物将会消失。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: And once this has happened, it may take the soil thousands of years to recover.
sentences.zh: 一旦发生这种情况,土壤可能需要数千年才能恢复。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Agriculture is by far the biggest problem.
sentences.zh: 农业是迄今为止最大的问题。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In the wild, when plants grow they remove nutrients from the soil, but then when the plants die and decay these nutrients are returned directly to the soil.
sentences.zh: 在野外,当植物生长时,它们会从土壤中吸收养分,但当植物死亡和腐烂时,这些养分会直接返回土壤。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Humans tend not to return unused parts of harvested crops directly to the soil to enrich it, meaning that the soil gradually becomes less fertile.
sentences.zh: 人类往往不会将收获的农作物未使用的部分直接返还到土壤中以使其肥沃,这意味着土壤逐渐变得不那么肥沃。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In the past we developed strategies to get around the problem, such as regularly varying the types of crops grown, or leaving fields uncultivated for a season.
sentences.zh: 过去,我们制定了解决该问题的策略,例如定期改变种植的农作物类型,或者让田地在一个季节内不耕种。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: D But these practices became inconvenient as populations grew and agriculture had to be run on more commercial lines.
sentences.zh: D 但随着人口的增长和农业必须在更多的商业线路上运行,这些做法变得不方便。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: A solution came in the early 20th century with the Haber-Bosch process for manufacturing ammonium nitrate.
sentences.zh: 20 世纪初期出现了一种解决方案,采用 Haber-Bosch 工艺生产硝酸铵。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Farmers have been putting this synthetic fertiliser on their fields ever since.
sentences.zh: 从那时起,农民就一直在他们的田地里施用这种合成肥料。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: But over the past few decades, it has become clear this wasn't such a bright idea.
sentences.zh: 但在过去的几十年里,很明显这并不是一个好主意。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Chemical fertilisers can release polluting nitrous oxide into the atmosphere and excess is often washed away with the rain, releasing nitrogen into rivers.
sentences.zh: 化肥会向大气中释放污染性的一氧化二氮,过量的一氧化二氮通常会被雨水冲走,从而将氮释放到河流中。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: More recently, we have found that indiscriminate use of fertilisers hurts the soil itself, turning it acidic and salty, and degrading the soil they are supposed to nourish.
sentences.zh: 最近,我们发现滥用化肥会损害土壤本身,使土壤变酸和变咸,并使它们本应滋养的土壤退化。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: E One of the people looking for a solution to this problem is Pius Floris, who started out running a tree-care business in the Netherlands, and now advises some of the world’s top soil scientists.
sentences.zh: E Pius Floris 是寻找这一问题解决方案的人之一,他一开始在荷兰经营树木护理业务,现在为一些世界顶级土壤科学家提供建议。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: He came to realise that the best way to ensure his trees flourished was to take care of the soil, and has developed a cocktail of beneficial bacteria, fungi and humus* to do this.
sentences.zh: 他开始意识到,确保树木茂盛的最佳方法是照顾土壤,并开发了一种由有益细菌、真菌和腐殖质*组成的混合物来做到这一点。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Researchers at the University of Valladolid in Spain recently used this cocktail on soils destroyed by years of fertiliser overuse.
sentences.zh: 西班牙巴利亚多利德大学的研究人员最近在因多年过度使用化肥而破坏的土壤上使用了这种混合物。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: When they applied Floris’s mix to the desert-like test plots, a good crop of plants emerged that were not just healthy at the surface, but had roots strong enough to pierce dirt as hard as rock.
sentences.zh: 当他们将弗洛里斯的混合物应用于类似沙漠的试验田时,出现了一批好植物,它们不仅表面健康,而且根部足够强大,可以刺穿像岩石一样坚硬的泥土。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The few plants that grew in the control plots, fed with traditional fertilisers, were small and weak.
sentences.zh: 在使用传统肥料的对照地块中生长的少数植物又小又弱。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: F However, measures like this are not enough to solve the global soil degradation problem.
sentences.zh: F 然而,这样的措施不足以解决全球土壤退化问题。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: To assess our options on a global scale we first need an accurate picture of what types of soil are out there, and the problems they face.
sentences.zh: 为了在全球范围内评估我们的选择,我们首先需要准确了解那里的土壤类型以及它们面临的问题。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: That’s not easy.
sentences.zh: 这并不容易。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: For one thing, there is no agreed international system for classifying soil.
sentences.zh: 一方面,国际上没有商定的土壤分类系统。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In an attempt to unify the different approaches, the UN has created the Global Soil Map project.
sentences.zh: 为了统一不同的方法,联合国创建了全球土壤图项目。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Researchers from nine countries are working together to create a map linked to a database that can be fed measurements from field surveys, drone surveys, satellite imagery, lab analyses and so on to provide real-time data on the state of the soil.
sentences.zh: 来自九个国家的研究人员正在共同创建一张链接到数据库的地图,该数据库可以输入来自现场调查、无人机调查、卫星图像、实验室分析等的测量结果,以提供有关土壤状况的实时数据。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Within the next four years, they aim to have mapped soils worldwide to a depth of 100 metres, with the results freely accessible to all.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的四年内,他们的目标是绘制全球 100 米深度的土壤图,并将结果免费提供给所有人。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: G But this is only a first step.
sentences.zh: G 但这只是第一步。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: We need ways of presenting the problem that bring it home to governments and the wider public, says Pamela Chasek at the International Institute for Sustainable Development, in Winnipeg, Canada.
sentences.zh: 加拿大温尼伯国际可持续发展研究所的帕梅拉·查塞克 (Pamela Chasek) 表示,我们需要向政府和广大公众提出问题的方法。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: 'Most scientists don't speak language that policy-makers can understand, and vice versa.
sentences.zh: '大多数科学家不会说政策制定者可以理解的语言,反之亦然。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: , Chasek and her colleagues have proposed a goal of ‘zero net land degradation,.
sentences.zh: ,Chasek 和她的同事提出了“零净土地退化”的目标。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Like the idea of carbon neutrality, it is an easily understood target that can help shape expectations and encourage action.
sentences.zh: 就像碳中和的想法一样,这是一个易于理解的目标,可以帮助塑造期望并鼓励采取行动。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: For soils on the brink, that may be too late.
sentences.zh: 对于濒临崩溃的土壤,这可能为时已晚。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Several researchers are agitating for the immediate creation of protected zones for endangered soils.
sentences.zh: 一些研究人员正在呼吁立即为濒危土壤建立保护区。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: One difficulty here is defining what these areas should conserve: areas where the greatest soil diversity is present?
sentences.zh: 这里的一个困难是定义这些地区应该保护什么：土壤多样性最丰富的地区？

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Or areas of unspoilt soils that could act as a future benchmark of quality?
sentences.zh: 或者未受破坏的土壤区域可以作为未来的质量基准？

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Whatever we do, if we want our soils to survive, we need to take action now.
sentences.zh: 无论我们做什么,如果我们希望我们的土壤生存,我们就需要立即采取行动。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

items.prompt: Healthy soil contains a large variety of bacteria and other microorganisms, as well as plant remains and……………
It provides us with food and also with antibiotics, and its function in storing …………… has a significant effect on the climate.
In addition, it prevents damage to property and infrastructure because it holds …………….
The main factor contributing to soil degradation is the ……………… carried out by humans
Nutrients contained in the unused parts of harvested crops
Synthetic fertilisers produced with the Haber-Bosch process
Addition of a mixture developed by Pius Floris to the soil
The idea of zero net soil degradation
A reference to one person’s motivation for a soil-improvement project

A reason why it is difficult to provide an overview of soil degradation
